coverage_notes.notes: Bounded supplementary recall watch only; production collection remains authoritative. CMS Public Notices showed no notice newer than 2026-09-25. Twelve targeted searches covering hospital/ED/maternity/behavioral-health/dialysis/oncology/primary-care closures or suspensions, rural/emergency service loss, ambulance/air-medical/base closures or suspensions, essential-service restorations, and U.S. territories found no new qualifying development in the bounded hourly window. Older, already-announced, proposed, non-U.S., business-only, and duplicate items were excluded.
